name: Buon Ma Thuot
provinceNote: From 1 July 2025 Phu Yen and Dak Lak are one province, and the administrative center is Buon Ma Thuot. The coast is in the same province on paper. The city is still a highland coffee town, not a beach stop.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: The coffee capital of the Central Highlands. Drink a slow phin, see the coffee museum and Dray Nur, take the dugout on Lak Lake, and eat bún đỏ on Le Hong Phong in the afternoon. Two days suits coffee lovers heading into the highlands.
fee: No single city ticket. Museums, the coffee museum, and the waterfalls each charge their own.
getThere: Buon Ma Thuot Airport (BMV). About 60 minutes from Ho Chi Minh City
seoTitle: Buon Ma Thuot travel guide — coffee, the museum, Lak Lake
seoDescription: Robusta country: the World Coffee Museum, the 250 m Dray Nur waterfall, and bún đỏ on Le Hong Phong from 15:00. About 60 minutes by air from Ho Chi Minh City.
intro: Start with a phin. Buon Ma Thuot trades in robusta, and the morning is a slow drip on a low table before the heat. October 10 Square, Quảng trường 10 tháng 3, is the roundabout in the middle of town: a tank under a white arch, a statue on the column, motorbikes circling. Stay when the highland coffee day is the trip. Choose Nha Trang when it is the beach, and Da Lat when it is the pine hills.

Late morning is the coffee museum. The World Coffee Museum stands on Nguyen Dinh Chieu in Tan Loi. An adult ticket is 150,000 VND and a child from 7 to 12 pays 40,000 VND. The shows are sold separately. The museum lists two sets of hours, 7:00–18:00 and 8:00–17:00, so go between 8:00 and 17:00 to be safe. Trung Nguyen Coffee Village is a different campus on the edge of town, with coffee gardens and longhouse displays, on its own ticket.

Dak Lak Museum and Bao Dai Palace share 02 Y Ngong, a short ride from the downtown hotels. The museum is three floors of ethnology, history, and natural history, at 30,000 VND for an adult and 20,000 VND for a child. Go on a weekday morning to miss the school groups, and walk out to the longhouse model behind the building. The palace is the 1926 French-era villa later used by Bao Dai, a monument rather than a hotel, and 45 to 60 minutes covers it. The old prison at 18 Tan Thuat is the yellow French-built compound kept as a heritage site. Give it 45 minutes in the morning.

Noon is too early for bún đỏ. The stalls on Le Hong Phong open from about 15:00 or 16:00: thick red noodles in a pork-and-crab broth, with shrimp paste on the side. Before that, Khải Đoan pagoda in the Phan Boi Chau area takes 30 to 45 minutes, and late afternoon softens the light on its wooden hall. Ako Dhong, on the north edge, is the quiet evening: Êđê longhouses and garden cafes, free to walk through.

The half-day south is Dray Nur, a curtain about 250 m wide on the Serepok, about 25 to 30 km out by car. Swim only where the staff allow it. The rock is slippery. Lak Lake, about 45 km east, is a dugout at sunset: a boat at Buon Jun is 80,000 VND for 30 minutes, and the Lak tourism area charges 150,000 VND for two guests for 30 minutes. Yok Don, about 40 km west, is a walk beside retired elephants, not a ride. The park operator's half day runs 08:00–11:00 or 13:30–16:30, at 850,000 VND for the first adult and 650,000 VND for each extra guest, plus park entry of 60,000 VND for an adult, 20,000 VND for a Vietnamese student, and 10,000 VND for a child. Book ahead, because elephant time is limited, and confirm full-day prices when you book.
gettingAround: Fly into Buon Ma Thuot Airport (BMV), in Hoa Thang commune. Flights from Ho Chi Minh City take about 60 minutes and from Hanoi about 1 hour 45 minutes. Da Nang has flights too. By road the city is about 350 km from Ho Chi Minh City, roughly 8 hours by bus at about 200,000–400,000 VND, and about 1,400 km from Hanoi. Da Lat is the road over the hills. There is no passenger train.

In town, Grab and taxis do the work. The coffee museum, Khải Đoan, the prison, and Y Ngong are all short rides from the hotels around Nguyen Tat Thanh and Le Duan. Dray Nur, Lak Lake, Yok Don, and Ea Kao need a car or a tour. Ea Kao is the nearer lake, just south of town. Do not confuse it with Lak. Rain slows the hill roads, so leave slack on a waterfall or lake day.

stayAreas.name: City center
stayAreas.summary: Hotels around Nguyen Tat Thanh and Le Duan keep October 10 Square, Y Ngong, Khải Đoan, and the bun do streets a short ride away.

eat: Bún đỏ on Le Hong Phong from about 15:00 or 16:00, bánh ướt chồng đĩa on Trần Nhật Duật or Lê Thánh Tông, and cơm lam with grilled chicken and a jar of rượu cần. The food guide has the rest of the Êđê table.
interestsBody: Dining is bún đỏ in the afternoon, bánh ướt chồng đĩa, and cơm lam with the jar. The food guide is the menu.
Pagodas and the square are Khải Đoan's lantern-hung hall in Phan Boi Chau and October 10 Square, the coffee festival stage.
Waterfalls and lakes are Dray Nur on the Serepok, Lak Lake at sunset, and Ea Kao closer to town.
Museums and the prison are the Y Ngong campus, with Bao Dai's villa, and the yellow compound at 18 Tan Thuat.
Coffee is a phin in the morning, the World Coffee Museum on Nguyen Dinh Chieu, and Trung Nguyen Coffee Village. Ako Dhong's longhouses and Yok Don's elephant walk are the village side of the trip.

interestGroups.title: Dining and F&B
interestGroups.summary: Bún đỏ on Le Hong Phong, bánh ướt chồng đĩa, and cơm lam with the jar.
body: Bún đỏ is the afternoon bowl on Le Hong Phong, from about 15:00 or 16:00. Bánh ướt chồng đĩa, the stacked rice sheets, are on Trần Nhật Duật and Lê Thánh Tông. For the Êđê meal of cơm lam in bamboo, grilled yard chicken, and rượu cần from the jar, go to Ko Tam or to Buon Tri A in Buon Don.
Bitter eggplant, canh thụt, and the forest greens are the other plates on an Êđê table. The food guide has the full list.

cards.title: Dining and F&B
cards.summary: Bún đỏ on Le Hong Phong, bánh ướt chồng đĩa, and cơm lam with the jar.

interestGroups.title: Pagodas and the square
interestGroups.summary: Khải Đoan is the large pagoda in town. October 10 Square is the festival stage.
body: October 10 Square, Quảng trường 10 tháng 3, is the open plaza in the center, free to walk and quiet on an ordinary evening. In a festival year it is the coffee festival's main stage. The ninth edition ran 9–13 March 2025, opening at 20:00 on 10 March and closing at 20:00 on 13 March, with a street parade from the Ngã Sáu monument at 15:30 on the opening day. The festival comes round every two years, so confirm the 2027 dates before you plan around it.

Khải Đoan sits in the Phan Boi Chau area: a wooden hall hung with yellow lanterns, a carved stair, and a white pavilion in the courtyard. Allow 30 to 45 minutes, in the late afternoon for the softer light on the roof. Leave a donation if one is asked, and do not fly a drone without permission.

cards.title: Khai Doan Pagoda
cards.summary: Wooden hall, yellow lanterns, and a white pavilion in Phan Boi Chau. Allow 30 to 45 minutes.

interestGroups.title: Waterfalls and lakes
interestGroups.summary: Dray Nur is the half-day on the Serepok. Lak Lake and Ea Kao are the other water.
body: Dray Nur is a curtain about 250 m wide on the Serepok, in Krong Ana, about 25 to 30 km south. Give it a half day with the drive. Swim only where the staff allow it, because the rock is slippery. The gate price changed in December 2024, so pay what the board shows.

Lak Lake is about 45 km east, and sunset is the hour. A dugout at Buon Jun is 80,000 VND for 30 minutes, and the Lak tourism area charges 150,000 VND for two guests for 30 minutes. It is a freshwater lake, not a beach. Ea Kao is the nearer lake, just south of the city, for a lakeside walk or a picnic in the late afternoon.

cards.title: Dray Nur
cards.summary: A 250 m curtain on the Serepok, about 25 to 30 km south. Give it a half day.

interestGroups.title: Museums and the prison
interestGroups.summary: Y Ngong holds the museum and Bao Dai’s villa. The old prison is on Tan Thuat.
body: Dak Lak Museum is at 02 Y Ngong: three floors of ethnology, history, and natural history. Plan on one to two hours, on a weekday morning if you want fewer school groups. An adult ticket is 30,000 VND and a child pays 20,000 VND. Walk out to the longhouse model behind the building.

Bao Dai Palace is the 1926 villa at the same address, a monument rather than a hotel, and 45 to 60 minutes covers it. The prison at 18 Tan Thuat, in Tu An, is the French-built compound kept as a revolutionary heritage site. Go in the morning and give it 45 minutes for the blue doors and the barred cell blocks.

cards.title: Buon Ma Thuot Prison
cards.summary: The yellow French-built compound at 18 Tan Thuat. Allow 45 minutes in the morning.

season.label: November to April
season.note: Rain slows the hill roads, so leave slack on a waterfall or lake day. In a festival year the coffee festival fills October 10 Square in March. It runs every two years, and the ninth edition was 9–13 March 2025. Confirm the 2027 dates before you book around it.

faqs.a: Downtown, around Nguyen Tat Thanh and Le Duan. Y Ngong, the square, and the afternoon bún đỏ streets are a short ride away. Lak Lake and Yok Don are day trips, not the usual hotel address.
From about 15:00 or 16:00 on Le Hong Phong. Noon is too early, so make it the mid-afternoon stop after Khải Đoan or the museums.

Every two years in March, with the main stage on October 10 Square. The ninth edition ran 9–13 March 2025: the opening at 20:00 on 10 March, a street parade from the Ngã Sáu monument at 15:30 that afternoon, and the closing at 20:00 on 13 March. The Buon Don elephant fair was on the same week's program. Confirm the 2027 dates before you book.

faqs.q: Is this a beach trip after the Phu Yen merger?
faqs.a: From 1 July 2025 Phu Yen and Dak Lak are one province, and the administrative center is Buon Ma Thuot. The city is still the highland coffee town. The coast is a separate ride. Nha Trang is its own trip.
Fly into BMV: about 60 minutes from Ho Chi Minh City and about 1 hour 45 minutes from Hanoi, then a taxi or Grab into town. There is no passenger train.
